_meta.name: Signal OS — Cross-Vertical Signal-Channel Catalog
_meta.purpose: Structured catalog of public/near-public data feeds that carry credit/risk/operating signals across muni, buyside-DD, and equity verticals. Used to (1) reason about signal-to-price latency, (2) discover redundancy clusters, (3) drive the masking-mechanism + microstructure-knowledge layer.

channels.name: CDIAC Yearly Fiscal Status Report (YFSR)
channels.publisher: California Debt and Investment Advisory Commission (state treasurer's office)
channels.lag_explanation: CA Mello-Roos fiscal year ends 6/30; YFSRs due to CDIAC by 10/30 (~120 days). Aggregate summary report (Figures 1-13) published in Jan of following calendar year (~6-7 mo after FY end).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-CFD: delinquency %, V/L ratio, principal outstanding, AV, reserve fund balance vs minimum, foreclosure parcels + commencement date, Teeter Plan participation flag, top-taxpayer fields (partial), late-filing count. Aggregate: 1,829 issues / 1,177 CFDs / $16.3B principal RY2023-24.
channels.access_method: PDF aggregate annual + per-issuer PDF on CDIAC DebtWatch portal
channels.access_gating: free, no paywall; some historical years 404 on direct URL
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: FALSIFIED for timing alpha (CFD_TIMING_ALPHA_TEST.md): YFSR lags court-filings + Default & Draw filings by 1-13 months; market repriced Diablo Grande to 65c BEFORE first detector fire. Useful as classification/diligence signal, not timing.
channels._notes: Mandatory under SB 165. 98.1% compliance in RY2023-24. Teeter Plan masks delinquency in ~half of CA counties (Solano, San Joaquin, Santa Cruz, El Dorado are Teeter; Mello-Roos typically Teeter-EXCLUDED so this caveat is mild for CFDs but strong for ad valorem).

channels.name: CDIAC Default and Draw on Reserve Database
channels.publisher: California Debt and Investment Advisory Commission
channels.lag_explanation: CDIAC notification required within 10 days of reserve draw or principal/interest default per Cal Govt Code (mandatory). Often appears on EMMA as a Material Event filing contemporaneously.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-issue: reserve-fund draw amount + date, principal/interest payment default date + amount, fiscal-agent name. RY 2023-24 saw 8 draws (3 Calexico + 3 Northstar + 2 Diablo Grande) and 2 defaults (both Truckee Donner).
channels.access_method: Web search form (issuer-name query) + EMMA Material Events feed
channels.access_gating: free, no paywall; bulk extract not exposed (per LANDSECURED_VALIDATION_PASS open-gap list)
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: FALSIFIED — Diablo Grande 1st reserve draw filed Sept 2018 contemporaneously with first plausible dealer-mark repricing. Co-incident with price moves, not leading.
channels._notes: Most-immediate public confirmation of CFD distress. Sophisticated dealers reprice within days. CDIAC + EMMA both carry the event; first-to-publish unclear but both intra-week.

channels.name: MSRB EMMA — Continuing Disclosure (Govt Code 53359.5)
channels.publisher: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board (MSRB) on behalf of CFD issuers
channels.lag_explanation: Per Govt Code 53359.5 + standard CFD continuing-disclosure agreements: issuers report total delinquency $, parcel count, and per-developed-parcel delinquencies ≥ semi-annual installment, filed on the semi-annual special-tax billing cycle. Typical filing ~30-60 days post-billing.
channels.what_it_carries: Parcel-level delinquency, top-taxpayer concentration (in CDA section), build-out %, debt service coverage, foreclosure proceedings. Filed by CFD administrators (David Taussig, NBS, Webb Municipal) on behalf of issuer.
channels.access_method: EMMA web search by obligor name or CUSIP; ToU restricts programmatic scraping
channels.access_gating: free, ToU boilerplate blocks naive scraping (per CFD_TIMING_ALPHA_TEST.md); manual lookup feasible
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Dominant leading public source (CFD_UPSTREAM_DATA_TEST.md): issuer continuing disclosure leads county tax-default-list publication and CDIAC YFSR. Co-incident with court foreclosure complaints. Not exploitable for timing alpha — fully dealer-visible.
channels._notes: The lead public source for CFD parcel-level delinquency. CFD administrators (David Taussig, NBS, Webb Municipal) publish CDA parcel detail — this is the source for build-out % + top-taxpayer detail not in YFSR.

channels.name: MSRB EMMA — Material Events (SEC Rule 15c2-12)
channels.publisher: MSRB on behalf of muni issuers/obligors
channels.lag_explanation: Rule 15c2-12 requires material-event filing within 10 business days of: rating changes, defaults, draws on reserves, bondholder consents, modifications, redemptions, tender offers, unscheduled draws on credit/liquidity facilities, defeasances. Many obligors file faster.
channels.what_it_carries: All Rule 15c2-12 events. For our universe: covenant-amendment events (the M&A leverage detector — the ONLY signal that survived blind OOS), rating actions, reserve draws, defaults, fiscal-agent changes.
channels.access_method: EMMA web; commercial feeds via Bloomberg, ICE, DPC DATA
channels.access_gating: EMMA web free; programmatic blocked by ToU
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Mixed. M&A leverage covenant-event detector survived blind OOS (+6 pp lift, 100% precision, 6% fire rate — only detector that did). General material-event monitoring is co-incident with sophisticated-dealer repricing.
channels._notes: The single highest-value muni channel for the framework — M&A leverage event detector is the only signal that survived blind OOS testing per the detector-composition memory.

channels.name: California Govt Code 53356.1 Court Foreclosure Filings
channels.publisher: CFD-issuer-initiated; filed in CA Superior Court (county-level dockets)
channels.url_pattern: Per-county Superior Court docket portals (e.g., Placer Superior Court for Northstar; Trellis.law for some aggregation)
channels.lag_explanation: CFDs are required to commence judicial foreclosure on delinquent parcels no later than October 1 each year when delinquency thresholds are met (typically >5%). Court complaints are public from day-of-filing.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-CFD foreclosure complaint filings naming delinquent property owners + delinquent amount. ACM Northstar complaint 2018-04-04 ($310K); Mountainside Builders 2019-06-04 ($4.9M); World International (Diablo Grande) WHWD vs World Intl CV-24-003049.
channels.access_method: Per-county Superior Court docket search; PACER for federal; Trellis.law surfaces some
channels.access_gating: Public docket — free with court portal navigation. Per-county fragmentation makes batch difficult.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Predates county tax-default-list publication by ~5 months (CFD_UPSTREAM_DATA_TEST.md). Dealer desks tracking CFD names monitor court dockets. No exploitable timing alpha; structurally the earliest mandatory-public signal of CFD distress.
channels._notes: Statutory mechanism mandates a public signal — this is what makes CFD distress un-arbitrageable on a developer-credit basis.

channels.name: California County Tax-Default List (R&T Code §3371-§3372)
channels.publisher: Per-county Tax Collector (Stanislaus, Placer, Imperial, Riverside, San Bernardino, etc.)
channels.lag_explanation: 1st installment delinquent Dec 10; 2nd installment delinquent Apr 10; tax-default status crystallizes July 1 of following FY; default list published in newspapers ~Aug-Sept (e.g., Placer Sept 8) = 5-10 months lag from underlying delinquency event.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-parcel APN + owner + delinquent amount. Annual snapshot only; no mid-year query for current-year delinquency status from any of the 3 counties tested (Stanislaus, Placer, Imperial).
channels.access_method: Per-county PDF; newspaper publication; some county portal name-search
channels.access_gating: Free PDFs. No subscription-based current-year delinquency product offered by Stanislaus, Placer, or Imperial (assessor subscriptions $220-$15,500/yr cover assessment value + sales, NOT delinquency).
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: FALSIFIED for upstream alpha rescue (CFD_UPSTREAM_DATA_TEST.md). Net lead vs CDIAC YFSR = 1-3 months only; not the 6-12 months the hypothesis required. Issuer continuing disclosure beats it on cadence.
channels._notes: Investigated as potential upstream rescue for the falsified land-secured timing-alpha hypothesis. Concluded it doesn't lead public market sources enough to extract alpha.

channels.name: California County Recorder Notices of Default (NoD) / Trustee Sales (CC §2924)
channels.publisher: Per-county Recorder (Stanislaus, Placer, Riverside, San Bernardino, Sacramento, San Joaquin, etc.)
channels.lag_explanation: Recorder records the document on the day filed (or next business day). NoD = first step in CC §2924 non-judicial foreclosure; trustee sale (NoTS) follows ~90+ days later.
channels.what_it_carries: Lender Notices of Default + Trustee Sale recordings against developer LLCs (e.g., BofA $157M NoD on East West Partners 2010-03-31 in Placer Co; LandSource $1.1B Barclays default 2008-04-22).
channels.access_method: Per-county recorder portal name-search (free grantor-name lookup). PropertyShark/PropertyRadar aggregate; borrower-name behind paywall on free tier.
channels.access_gating: Free per-county portals; commercial aggregators paywall the cross-county view (PropertyShark $99/mo, PropertyRadar 5-day CC trial).
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: PARTIALLY-VALIDATED for diligence-replication, NOT alpha (CFD_RECORDER_DATA_BUILD.md). Detector built + unit-tested (nod_recorder_filing.py); expected fire rate ~3-6% on full CFD universe. Lender NoDs frequently precede CFD-level distress by 12-24 months — useful but already-public.
channels._notes: Investigator-level public source — sophisticated dealer desks track but not algorithmically watched. Cross-state version is referenced in buyside_dd source_atlas under PARCEL.mortgage_records (WPRDC, ACRIS, Wayne Co).

channels.name: CMS Care Compare — Nursing Home Provider Info (Star Ratings)
channels.publisher: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
channels.lag_explanation: CMS refreshes provider-info file monthly; star-rating components (health-inspection, staffing, QM) recalculate quarterly. ~1 month lag from underlying inspection/event to CMS file refresh.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-facility CCN: overall star (1-5), health-inspection star, staffing star, QM star, RN hours, weighted total-CMP cumulative-24mo, DPNA flag, Abuse Icon flag.
channels.access_method: CMS bulk CSV download; per-facility web lookup
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: VALIDATED. Lead time vs muni rating action ~12-18 months. Caught 2/2 deteriorating obligors in 2023-2025 NH backtest with 100% precision; caught the one CA NH default in COVID-stress window 2020-2022. Effective except where Cal-Mortgage masking decouples operator credit from bond pricing.
channels._notes: Refresh quarterly minimum; Cal-Mortgage insurance wrap MASKS this signal for ~half of CA NH muni names (bondholders price insurer credit, not operator).

channels.name: CMS Special Focus Facility (SFF) List
channels.lag_explanation: CMS publishes the SFF list (worst-performing ~5% of NH nationally) monthly. Designation event-driven; publication monthly.
channels.what_it_carries: SFF designation status + SFF Candidate (watchlist); facility name + CCN.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: VALIDATED for classification. Fires on ~5% of CA NH universe, high precision. Signal again masked by Cal-Mortgage where applicable.
channels._notes: Designation triggers more-frequent surveys + potential termination from Medicare/Medicaid.

channels.name: CMS Nursing Home Enforcement Actions / Civil Monetary Penalties (CMP)
channels.lag_explanation: CMS publishes the enforcement-actions / CMP dataset monthly. Penalties accumulate over 24-month trailing window.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-facility CMP amount + date + DPNA (Denial of Payment for New Admissions) status.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Used in 5-detector NH framework (Ararat: $460K CMP + DPNA → 5 fires).
channels._notes: Cumulative >$500K in trailing 24mo OR active DPNA fires.

channels.name: CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) Penalty File
channels.lag_explanation: HRRP penalty announced August, effective October 1 each year (FY runs Oct 1 - Sept 30).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-hospital CMS_HRRP penalty % (0-3%); for systems: penalty share across constituent hospitals.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Lead time ~6-18 months vs muni rating action. Detector fires only at max (3.00%) — narrow high-precision per the detector-composition discipline.
channels._notes: Penalty caps at 3.00%; Medicare ~30-50% of hospital revenue → ~1.2% of total revenue at max.

channels.name: CMS HCRIS — Medicare Cost Reports (Form 2552 / 2540 / 1728)
channels.lag_explanation: Hospitals/SNFs/HHA file cost reports annually within ~5 months of FY end; CMS HCRIS publishes the extract ~3-6 months after that. ~9 months total lag, sometimes longer for revisions.
channels.what_it_carries: Facility-level revenue mix, Medicare/Medicaid days, operating expenses, net income. Steward Health Care's Medicare-margin deterioration was visible 18 months before MPW disclosure.
channels.access_method: CMS Open Data API + bulk SAS extracts; m_sources/cms_cost_reports.py connector
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Forward-looking for healthcare-REIT tenant distress (Steward → MPW pattern documented).
channels._notes: Form 2552 (hospital) UUID c40fae1f-99a7-4d7f-b94e-fa9989b3c486; Form 2540 (SNF) 56a8a4cb-2cc4-43b1-8eee-b2dfe2c92bda; Form 1728 (HHA) cea7ec1e-6c4c-4866-934d-7a5d8b3e6c4a.

channels.name: HHS-OIG Corporate Integrity Agreements (CIA) List
channels.lag_explanation: OIG publishes new CIAs within ~2 weeks of imposition. List is the active-CIA roster (typically 5 years per CIA).
channels.what_it_carries: Active CIA party + start date + expiration; underlying allegations.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Lead time ~6-18 months for operational changes affecting financials.
channels._notes: CIA = 5-year structural compliance overhead burden.

channels.name: DOJ False Claims Act Press Releases / Settlements
channels.url_pattern: https://www.justice.gov/news  (filtered to civil division + healthcare fraud)
channels.lag_explanation: DOJ press release issued day-of-settlement. Underlying investigation may have been multi-year.
channels.what_it_carries: Settlement amount, allegation, intervention status, parties.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector fires on >$25M settlement OR DOJ-intervened pending complaint (Erlanger case).
channels._notes: DOJ-intervened complaints fire HIGH even pre-settlement.

channels.name: HCAI (formerly OSHPD) Seismic Safety List of Buildings (SB 1953 / SB 90)
channels.publisher: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)
channels.lag_explanation: HCAI updates the SPC (Standard Performance Category) list multiple times per year as buildings re-evaluate, achieve extensions, or fail re-certification.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-building SPC rating (SPC-1 through SPC-5), funded-extension status, deadline year (2030).
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Lead time 3-7 years vs 2030 deadline. Detector tightened post-CA-test (≥5 unfunded SPC-2 buildings OR any unfunded SPC-2 in stressed obligor).
channels._notes: Required retrofit ~$100M+ per hospital for SPC-2 → SPC-4 conversion.

channels.name: HCAI Cal-Mortgage Loan Insurance Division — Monthly Activity Report
channels.publisher: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI) — Cal-Mortgage Loan Insurance Division
channels.lag_explanation: HCAI publishes monthly activity reports ~30 days after month-end with portfolio claim activity, new commitments, and payment events.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-Cal-Mortgage-insured obligor: claim activity (e.g., bondholder payment date 2022-10-31 for CalPFA O'Connor Woods), new commitments, payment events. Aggregate insurance pool exposure.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Best primary source for confirming Cal-Mortgage insurance status (per ca_nh_clean_basket_bonds.json). Hedge value rather than steady alpha — relevant for insurer-cascade tail risk. As of 2026-05-28: trailing 18mo shows 1 active cascade event — St. Rose Hospital (~$13.96M, May 2025 anticipated-recovery line first appearance). HFCLIF cash drew down ~$11M from Oct 2024 to Jun 2025. Wrap still intact (HFCLIF $127.8M > $75M statutory minimum) but cascade is real and ongoing.
channels._notes: Detector built 2026-05-28 (cal_mortgage_cascade_monitor). Second-order detector — fires only on Cal-Mortgage-INSURED obligors when claim cascade is active; inert on NOT_INSURED names. Cal-Mortgage is the dominant CA NH/CCRC masking mechanism — when this insurer faces a claim cascade, ALL wrapped names widen simultaneously. The cascade monitor modulates the interpretation of operator-credit detectors on wrapped names rather than replacing them. Primary report URL pattern (post-2024): https://hcai.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/{year}/{mm}/Monthly-Report-{Month}-{year}-Final-ADA-Compliant.pdf (note format change from 2022 pattern: Cal-Mortgage_Loan_Insurance_Division_Monthly_Activity_Report_{Month}_{year}.pdf).

channels.name: CDE Dataquest — Enrollment + Demographics
channels.lag_explanation: School-year ends June; enrollment data published October-December (~6-12 months from start of academic year, ~9-12 mo from school year end).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-CDS-code: enrollment by grade + year, demographic breakdown, A-G completion %.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Lead time ~12-24 months vs muni rating action (proposed; charter vertical scoping). Fires on 3-yr YoY enrollment ≤ -3% OR 5-yr cum ≤ -12%.
channels._notes: Detector built status: PROPOSED in charter sector scoping; not yet implemented.

channels.name: CAASPP — California Assessment of Student Performance
channels.lag_explanation: Spring testing; results published ~August-October following school year end.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-CDS-code ELA + Math % met/exceeded standard, by grade + subgroup.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector PROPOSED: fires when ELA+Math both bottom-quintile AND 3-yr trend ≤ -3pp.
channels._notes: Charter renewal often turns on CAASPP performance — partial leading indicator.

channels.name: CDE LCFF Per-Pupil Funding Data
channels.lag_explanation: LCFF apportionment calculated post-budget enactment; final per-pupil amounts published mid-year.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-LEA per-pupil base + supplemental + concentration grant amounts.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector PROPOSED: enrollment-driven LCFF revenue decline ≥ -3%/yr sustained 2yr.
channels._notes: Per Govt Code, CSFA Charter School Facility Program (CSFP) intercept routes LCFF apportionments to bond trustee for CSFP-supported deals (partial credit enhancement — analog to Cal-Mortgage but weaker).

channels.name: CDE Charter Schools Division — Renewal/Revocation Status
channels.publisher: California Department of Education, Charter Schools Division
channels.url_pattern: https://www.cde.ca.gov/sp/ch/  + per-authorizer board minutes (LAUSD CSD, LA COE, etc.)
channels.lag_explanation: Authorizer board action triggers public board-minute publication ~2-4 weeks; CDE roster reflects status changes irregularly.
channels.what_it_carries: Revocation, non-renewal, probation, or closure events.
channels.access_method: CDE web + LAUSD CSD board agenda + LA COE board agenda
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector PROPOSED — manual event-log curation required (no API).
channels._notes: Today's Fresh Start, Aveson, ICEF distress all surfaced through this channel.

channels.name: FCMAT (Fiscal Crisis & Management Assistance Team) Reports
channels.lag_explanation: Reviews initiated upon request or by state mandate; reports published ~3 months after fieldwork.
channels.what_it_carries: Fiscal-distress reviews of LEAs + charters, with findings and recommendations.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector PROPOSED.
channels._notes: Targeted, irregular cadence — high-precision when fires. FCMAT engagement is one of the inputs to coe_fiscal_certification detector (HIGH-severity trigger when an active fiscal-distress engagement exists).

channels.name: CA County Office of Education (COE) Quarterly Fiscal Certification (AB 1200)
channels.publisher: California Department of Education (CDE) consolidates per-county-COE certifications; individual COEs (Los Angeles COE, Sacramento COE, Fresno COE, El Dorado COE, etc.) issue the per-district certifications.
channels.lag_explanation: Per AB 1200 (Ed Code §42127.6 / §42131): First Interim covers period ending Oct 31, district board approves by Dec 15, COE reviews/certifies ~30-60 days later. Second Interim covers period ending Jan 31, district due Mar 17, COE certifies ~30-60 days later. CDE consolidates the statewide Q/N list ~60-90 days after COE certification. Total event-to-CDE-publication: ~3-4 months. (Empirical anchor: 2025-26 Second Interim covering period ended 2026-01-31 was published by CDE on 2026-05-26 = 115 days lag.)
channels.what_it_carries: Per-district certification status: Positive (will meet financial obligations), Qualified (may not meet obligations in current + 2 subsequent FY), Negative (will not meet obligations in current FY). Plus: district name, county, budget amount for the cycle. Each cycle's CDE list IS the authoritative public record.
channels.access_method: CDE web (consolidated PDF/HTML per cycle); per-COE board agenda for individual district certification letters; FCMAT reports for deeper detail
channels.access_gating: free, public; no API but consolidated HTML lists are stable URL patterns by year and cycle
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Lead time vs muni rating action: 12-24 months. Load-bearing anchors: SCUSD progression (2024-25 Q1 Positive → 2024-25 Q2 Qualified → 2025-26 Q1 Negative → Fitch IDR cut from A+ to BB- on 2026-04-28 — ~18-month lead from first Q to BB-); Pleasanton USD (2024-25 Q1 Positive → 2025-26 Q1 Negative — 12 month skip-Q jump); Plumas USD (Q since 2023 → FCMAT engagement Dec 2024 → projected cash insolvency Aug 2025 → state receivership — ~24-month timeline). Detector calibrated on 6-name ETF basket: 1/6 = 16.7% fire rate (River Delta = back-to-back Q, HIGH severity); universe baseline ~3-6% per cycle.
channels._notes: INTERACTION WITH `ca_k12_dedicated_tax_special_revenue` MASKING MECHANISM: A Q/N certification fires at the DISTRICT (obligor) level. The 5-notch Fitch criteria caps the spread between IDR and dedicated-tax GO rating — so a Q/N fire predicts IDR deterioration but the dedicated-tax GO can hold IG even at extreme distress (SCUSD: BB- IDR, BBB+ dedicated-tax GO). This means the COE detector should EXCLUDE ULTGO older-series (no pledged-special-revenue OS language), COPs, LRBs from the basket on fire — but dedicated-tax GO bonds with proper OS language may remain in BUY-ZONE as descending-ladder plays. The bond-series filter is applied downstream of the obligor-level detector fire.

channels.name: California State Controller Audits
channels.lag_explanation: Adverse-finding audits published ~6 months post-fieldwork.
channels.what_it_carries: Material audit findings against LEAs / muni borrowers.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Detector PROPOSED.
channels._notes: Triggers Govt-Code-mandated CFD foreclosure for special-district borrowers under intercept. Read by state_controller_intercept detector as the SCO_AUDIT_FINDING event source.

channels.name: CA State Controller Apportionment Payments (Monthly per-program payment lists)
channels.publisher: California State Controller's Office (SCO), Local Government Apportionments division
channels.lag_explanation: SCO posts per-program apportionment schedule + payment list within ~1-5 business days after each disbursement cycle. K-12 Schools cycle is monthly. Lottery Educational + Prop 30 EPA are quarterly. Annual Payment Schedule PDFs published Jul/Aug for upcoming FY.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-program (Schools K-12, Community Colleges, Prop 30 K-12, Prop 30 CC, Lottery Educational, plus 50+ realignment / trial-court / local-aid programs), per-recipient payment amount + date. CRITICAL: SCO publishes the PAYMENT schedule but the canonical per-pupil LCFF allocation is computed by CDE Principal Apportionment Section (PASE) at https://www.cde.ca.gov/fg/aa/pa/. For CSFA-issued charter conduit deals, SCO is the actor that diverts LCFF apportionment to bond trustee under Ed Code 17199.4 — so a withholding or modification at SCO is the canonical alarm signal for the csfa_lcff_intercept masking mechanism.
channels.access_method: SCO public web; per-program HTML payment lists; annual Payment Schedule PDF
channels.access_gating: free, public; no API but stable URL patterns
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Monthly cadence + 5-day publication lag makes this the highest-frequency state-mediated apportionment channel for CA muni. A skipped or partial payment to a CSFA-issued charter conduit obligor or to a district receiving emergency apportionment loan under Ed Code 41320 is direct evidence of intercept-modification. No empirical anchor pulled yet — charter LCFF intercept has not been observably triggered in recent history; channel is read for signal-when-it-fires rather than routine apportionment-pattern alpha.
channels._notes: Taxonomy clarification (load-bearing for state_controller_intercept detector): SCO does NOT pay debt service on K-12 USD GO bonds. Under SB 222 (Cal. Gov't Code 53515), the dedicated property tax flows from the COUNTY tax collector direct to the bond trustee — SCO has no role. SCO IS the actor for: (a) CSFA charter-conduit LCFF intercept (Ed Code 17199.4); (b) state emergency apportionment loans to insolvent districts under Ed Code 41320 (district operations only, NOT bondholder cash flow); (c) general per-program apportionments to CA local agencies. The state_controller_intercept detector treats SCO payment activity as canonical channel for category (a) only. ETF-basket calibration 2026-05-28: 0 of 6 K-12 USD holdings are CSFA charter conduits, so SCO LCFF intercept channel is structurally not applicable to the K-12 USDs in the ETF; CDE Interim (ca_coe_ab1200_fiscal_certification channel) is the operative upstream signal.

channels.name: CA DOF ROPS Review Letters (Successor Agency RPTTF approval)
channels.publisher: California Department of Finance (DOF), Office of State Audits and Evaluations
channels.lag_explanation: Successor agencies submit annual ROPS to DOF by Feb 1 covering Jul 1 of that year through Jun 30 of next year. DOF must issue review letter within 60 days. Empirical anchors ROPS 25-26 cycle: Cloverdale 2025-02-28 (29 days after submission); San Jose 2025-03-21 (49 days); Fontana 2025-04-04 (67 days, at statutory cap).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-SA per-fiscal-year: total approved RPTTF distribution amount split into ROPS A (Jul-Dec) + ROPS B (Jan-Jun); per-line-item approval/denial decisions; administrative-cost notes (HSC 34171(b)(3) cap compliance); prior-period-adjustment (PPA) offsets; outstanding litigation flags. Bond debt service items typically Priority 2 in the 34183 waterfall (after pre-1994 pass-throughs); most refunding TABs use 34177.5(e) consent to subordinate pass-throughs to debt service, moving bond items to Priority 1.
channels.access_method: DOF web — per-letter PDF download; some county auditor sites mirror approved ROPS
channels.access_gating: free, public; per-letter URLs stable by cycle + agency snake_case name
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: VERIFIED — canonical claims-pay channel for rops_allocation_intercept masking mechanism. DOF denial of a bond-debt-service line is the highest-severity event possible (would trigger state_controller_intercept at HIGH; analog to SCO LCFF withholding). Empirical history: zero DOF denials of bond-debt items observed across verified universe (per masking_mechanisms.json rops_allocation_intercept — three host-BK positive controls SB/Stockton/Vallejo all showed uninterrupted TAB payment through host BK). ETF-basket calibration 2026-05-28: 3/3 SA holdings (San Jose $143M / Fontana $36.5M / Cloverdale $1.7M ROPS 25-26) approved-in-full; only ADMIN_NOTE events fired (filtered as non-binding).
channels._notes: Statutory basis: HSC 34177(o)(1) (annual ROPS submission); HSC 34177.5 (refunding-bond subordination); HSC 34183 (RPTTF waterfall). DOF review process: (1) sample line-item review; (2) apply law; (3) approve/deny per line; (4) note admin-cost cap compliance per HSC 34171(b)(3); (5) apply PPA offset from prior-cycle to current. Meet-and-Confer dispute path per HSC 34177(m) exists for SA-vs-DOF disagreements; bondholders structurally insulated because bond-debt items rarely disputed. This DOF letter is the upstream approval that gates the actual semi-annual county-auditor RPTTF distribution to the trustee — more authoritative for the rops_allocation_intercept signal than downstream EMMA continuing disclosure.

channels.name: Audited Financial Statements — Bond Covenant Compliance Section
channels.publisher: Per-obligor (issuer website + EMMA continuing disclosure attachment + ProPublica 990 audit attachment for 501(c)(3))
channels.url_pattern: Per-obligor IR / finance page; EMMA /IssuerHomePage/; ProPublica /nonprofits/{ein}/
channels.lag_explanation: Audits typically completed 90-180 days post-FYE; posted to issuer website + EMMA within ~7 months per typical CDA. CHFFA / CSFA conduit borrowers post to EMMA via dissemination agent.
channels.what_it_carries: Per-obligor verbatim covenant-compliance language. Three states: (a) 'in compliance with all financial covenants' (positive disclosure), (b) silent on covenants (ambiguous — possibly cured intra-year or no MTI covenants), (c) explicit 'non-compliance with financial covenants' with optional 'waiver obtained' or 'accelerated maturity' modifier. Master Trust Indenture obligors (hospitals, CCRCs, charters) carry the richest covenant set: days cash on hand, DSCR, debt-to-capitalization, additional bonds test, rate covenant. K-12 GO bonds carry NO MTI covenants (SB 222 statutory lien only). State GO carries no MTI covenants (full faith and credit).
channels.access_method: Free PDF download from issuer IR site, EMMA, or ProPublica. CONFIRMED in 2026-05-28 session: many issuer-site PDFs are binary-encoded and not text-extractable via WebFetch; require pdftotext or browser-fingerprint scrape.
channels.access_gating: Free but practically gated by PDF text-extraction toolchain; some sites (mwdh2o.com observed) 403 naive User-Agent
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Prototype catch validated 2026-05-28: Alliance College-Ready Public Schools FY25 audit disclosed 'non-compliance with financial covenants, waiver obtained' (per outputs/CA_CHARTER_INVESTMENT_THESIS_V2.md), moving Alliance from BUY list to EXCLUDE list. Detector regex correctly fires on prototype text. Lead time vs rating action: typically 3-12 months (auditors disclose covenant breach in same FY; agency review follows).
channels._notes: COMPLEMENTARY to covenant_tripwire.py: tripwire computes headroom from CURRENT metrics vs known covenant minimums (requires parameterized covenant_terms.json + cafr_overrides.json per obligor); this channel reads DISCLOSURE LANGUAGE for explicit breach text (higher precision, covers obligors without parameterized terms). HOSTILE-VALIDATOR RULE: silence is NOT 'no breach'; if audit can't be retrieved or text-extracted, detector returns UNVERIFIABLE. In 2026-05-28 ETF basket scan, 13/20 holdings returned UNVERIFIABLE for this reason — primary gap is PDF text-extraction toolchain, not absence of the underlying signal.

channels.name: CalPERS Public Agency Actuarial Valuation Reports (Per-Employer)
channels.url_pattern: https://www.calpers.ca.gov/page/employers/actuarial-services/employer-contributions  (per-employer PDF; one per plan: Misc, Safety, PEPRA tiers)
channels.lag_explanation: CalPERS measurement date = June 30 of FY end; per-employer reports published ~12 months later (June FY+1) for use in contribution-rate setting effective FY+2. Earliest preview comes via CalPERS preliminary investment-return press release in July (e.g., 11.6% return announce for FY2024-25 in July 2025).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-employer-plan: Market Value of Assets, Actuarial Liability, funded ratio (MVA / AL), Net Pension Liability (NPL), required contribution rates (employer normal cost % of payroll + UAL payment $), amortization schedule. Both Misc and Safety plans where applicable.
channels.access_method: Per-employer PDF download from CalPERS portal; aggregate funded-ratio figures in CalPERS ACFR
channels.access_gating: free, no paywall; per-employer search by employer name
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Trajectory (5-year slope) is the leading indicator: Stockton CalPERS Misc declined ~26pp over 5y (FY08 89% -> FY12 63%) before June 2012 Ch 9. Vallejo similar 4y decline before May 2008 Ch 9. Sacramento USD's CalSTRS exposure 5y decline preceded April 2026 Fitch BB- cut. Snapshot lags; trajectory leads by 12-36 months.
channels._notes: Stockton/San Bernardino Ch 9 rulings established CalPERS contributions are SENIOR to POB bondholders (CalPERS = special-status creditor under CA Govt Code; POB = unsecured general obligation). Funded-ratio decline = future cash-flow pressure on general fund that competes with all GO debt service. Per-employer reports cover Misc (general employees), Safety (police/fire/lifeguards), and PEPRA tiers separately.

channels.name: CalSTRS Defined Benefit Program Actuarial Valuation Reports
channels.lag_explanation: Measurement date June 30; report published ~12 months later. Funding-plan reports published quarterly; full actuarial valuation annual.
channels.what_it_carries: Systemwide DB funded ratio (76.7% as of June 30 2024 per CalSTRS 2024 valuation; $88.7B unfunded liability), historical funded-ratio series, employer/state/member contribution-rate path, AB 1469 funding-plan progress.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Trajectory at SYSTEMWIDE level is the public signal — per-district disaggregation is NOT available because CalSTRS DB Program is a cost-sharing multiple-employer plan (each K-12 district participates pro-rata via uniform contribution rate). Per-district variation surfaces only via GASB 68 net-pension-liability / governmental-fund-revenue multiples in each district's ACFR. Systemwide funded ratio improved FY20 67.1% -> FY24 76.7% during the window covered, anti-correlated with the Stockton-era pattern, so this signal does NOT currently flag distress for K-12 holdings.
channels._notes: K-12 districts cannot escape CalSTRS systemwide trajectory but can experience disproportionate stress when contribution rates rise faster than LCFF revenue (which is the Sacramento USD pattern). The CalSTRS systemwide trajectory is a NECESSARY-NOT-SUFFICIENT signal for K-12 distress; pair with enrollment / LCFF / ESSER-cliff detectors. Open gap: per-district GASB 68 NPL ratios for the ETF K-12 holdings list.

channels.name: GASB 68 Employer Pension Footnote (ACFR / CAFR Note)
channels.publisher: Per-employer (cities, counties, special districts, K-12, community colleges) in audited ACFR
channels.url_pattern: Per-employer ACFR — typically Note 11 or Note H 'Pension Plan'
channels.lag_explanation: ACFR issuance is FY-end + 6 months for most CA local govts (per state law; later for distressed/late filers — see late_filing detector). Pension note carries the measurement-date snapshot (typically 1-year lagged from ACFR issuance date).
channels.what_it_carries: Per-employer Net Pension Liability, plan-fiduciary-net-position-to-total-pension-liability ratio (the GASB version of funded ratio), service cost, sensitivity analysis (discount rate +1% / -1% NPL bands), schedule of contributions vs. actuarially determined contribution, deferred outflows/inflows from changes in assumptions.
channels.access_method: EMMA financial disclosure (PDF) + per-employer website Finance / Treasurer page
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: Provides per-employer trajectory where CalSTRS systemwide proxy is too coarse. For K-12 ETF holdings, this is the primary path to district-specific pension stress (e.g., Sacramento USD NPL / governmental-fund-revenue multiple).
channels._notes: GASB 68 NPL is computed using BLENDED discount rate (long-term assumed return for funded portion, muni bond yield for unfunded portion). channels.access_gating: free; outlet paywalls vary (LA Times / SF Chronicle have metered access); Bond Buyer is subscription. Google News query rate limits apply at scale.
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: FASTEST signal in the framework — news typically precedes formal rating actions by months and EMMA material-event filings by weeks. INITIAL CALIBRATION (2026-05-28, CA muni ETF 19-name basket): 4/19 = 21% fire rate. Sector skew: 3/4 CHFFA hospitals fire (Stanford open-ended nurses strike + $10M wage settlement + Lucile Packard layoffs; Providence Eureka CA AG Emergency Services enforcement; Adventist HHS-OIG CMP + CA AG patient-disclosure settlement + Roseville WARN); 1/6 K-12 fires (Clovis USD two Title IX lawsuit clusters trailing 12mo). Per honesty-alpha framework: news of HONESTLY DISCLOSED bad events is already in dealer-market price, so detector value is exclusion-screen + microstructure-confirmation rather than timing alpha.

Active-investigation language tags (DOJ_AG_ENFORCEMENT, NURSES_STRIKE_OPEN_ENDED, FCMAT_FISCAL_DISTRESS_REVIEW, STATE_RECEIVERSHIP, TITLE_IX_LITIGATION_CLUSTER, ACTIVE_FIRE_INVESTIGATION, SEC/FBI investigation, CRIMINAL_INDICTMENT_PUBLIC_OFFICIAL) bump severity. channels.name: Scheduler exhaust — booking-slot scarcity nowcast
channels.publisher: self-hosted appointment/reservation schedulers (booking widgets, wait-time postings)
channels.url_pattern: per-instance PanelSpec.scheduler_url (e.g. appointment.questdiagnostics.com; labcorp.com/labs-and-appointments); framework = desk/scheduler_exhaust.py
channels.mechanism: public booking-slot scarcity leaks utilization: days-to-next-available, %-same-day, and booking-horizon depth over a FIXED location panel move with operational load AHEAD of the reported volume print. Operational physical quantity, hard to fake, free to observe, too niche for alt-data vendors to productize.
channels.cadence: weekly (spot sample at a fixed weekday/hour per instance)
channels.lag_explanation: the slot state IS the event (zero observation lag); the corresponding reported volume prints 30-60d after quarter end, so the channel LEADS reported volume by 0-1 quarter.
channels.what_it_carries: per-location status (ok / no_slots / blocked=MISSING-never-zero), days-to-next-available-slot, %-same-day, %-within-48h, %-booked-out (right-censored at the visible booking horizon), panel coverage + sample quality. Aggregated per instance into desk/data/scheduler_exhaust/<ticker>_history.jsonl.
channels.applies_to: appointment/reservation-based service businesses with PUBLIC online booking (draw sites/labs, urgent-care & ER queue postings, salon online check-in, restaurant order-ahead/reservations, med-spa injectable providers, service bays). Book-wide applicability census: desk/data/scheduler_exhaust/candidates.json (2026-07-23: 7 yes / 18 indirect / 390 no over 415 ledger names) — UNSCREENED != CLEAR; coverage validator = `python3 -m desk.scheduler_exhaust --census-gaps`.
confounders: capacity-vs-demand: slot scarcity conflates demand with CAPACITY — staffing up shortens waits while volume rises; designated cross-check = hiring_velocity (same-site posting waves = capacity change)
spot-vs-average sampling: a weekly spot sample is not the average booking experience — fix the sampling weekday/hour per instance and read trends across snapshots, never one pull
channels.validation_status: PAPER — calibration seed = DGX/LH Q2-2026 frozen calls; the channel graduates only if it beats consensus through the Q3-2026 prints (October). No basket/sizing use before graduation.
redundant_channels: hiring_velocity (capacity side — the designated cross-check, not a substitute)
direct volume releases where they exist (state gaming monthlies, airport traffic) strictly dominate the proxy — see candidates.json notes on FLL/ASR/PAC
channels.access_method: browser_scrape (Playwright real-Chrome fingerprint, land-first-for-cookies, in-page fetch) + per-instance --manual CSV fallback
channels.access_gating: free; anti-bot WAFs on some targets — blocked locations are recorded as MISSING, never zero; >40% blocked marks the snapshot DEGRADED
channels.validated_for_alpha_lead: NOT YET — PAPER. Seed instance #1 = Quest/Labcorp lab-appointment panel (desk/lab_scheduler_panel.py). Frozen Q2-2026 calls grade at the Q3 prints; graduation requires beating consensus, not merely correlating.
